# CLI Reference

<!-- Generated by tools/generate_cli_reference.py; do not edit manually. -->

`experiment-redact` is the package's deliberately narrow sanitizer CLI. It
does not submit, cancel, or otherwise control experiments; controllers consume
the Python backend API for those operations.

```text
Redact credentials in experiment log text from standard input.

Usage: experiment-redact

Options:
  -h, --help      Print help
```
